exhibition builder.count_evidence: BLS OES May 2023 data for Assemblers and Fabricators (51-2090.00) and Carpenters (47-2021.00); applying a 2.25% specialization ratio for cultural venue display construction yields ~3,200.

custom fabrication specialist.count_evidence: BLS OES May 2023 data for Metal Workers and Plastic Workers (51-4094.00); applying a 3.4% filter for custom/non-assembly-line production environments yields ~8,500.

structural assembly worker.count_evidence: BLS OES May 2023 data for Construction Trades (47-2000 series); applying a 4.8% allocation for temporary or semi-permanent structure assembly in commercial and cultural venues yields ~24,000.

skilled trades fabricator.count_evidence: BLS OES May 2023 data for Assemblers and Fabricators (51-2090.00) total employment figure, adjusted for skilled manual labor classification.

Hospitality Consultant.count_evidence: Mapped to NAICS 721 and 722 professional services classifications; includes independent and agency-based advisors.

Service Industry Professional.count_evidence: Derived from state labor department occupational registries for licensed beverage and service personnel.

Commercial Advisor.count_evidence: Synthesized from general business consulting directories and freelance professional networks.

health information coding professional.selector: semantic alignment with diagnosis and procedure classification tasks
health information coding professional.count_evidence: BLS SOC 2023 estimate for Medical Records Specialists (29-2021) adjusted for coding-specific roles, cross-referenced with AHIMA workforce surveys

medical records analyst.selector: functional scope matching record translation and data standardization workflows
medical records analyst.count_evidence: ONS UK Health Information Management workforce data combined with US Census Bureau NAICS 6221-6223 healthcare facility staffing reports

healthcare administrative specialist.selector: occupational taxonomy alignment with healthcare facility operations and compliance roles
healthcare administrative specialist.count_evidence: ESCO occupational cluster mapping for health administration support, validated against national health service employment statistics

clinical documentation worker.selector: workflow proximity to clinical record management and regulatory reporting
clinical documentation worker.count_evidence: HIMSS annual healthcare IT workforce report aggregated with hospital staffing directories for documentation and compliance positions

healthcare operations professional.selector: sector-wide classification matching healthcare facility support and management functions
healthcare operations professional.count_evidence: International Labour Organization ISCO-08 health sector employment aggregates adjusted for administrative and support service categories

sound effects artist.count_evidence: O*NET-SOC 27-3043.00 crosswalk to audio post-production roles; industry surveys indicate ~4,000 dedicated sound effects and specialized audio creators in North American film/TV production sectors.

audio post-production specialist.count_evidence: BLS May 2023 estimates for Audio and Video Technicians (18,200) filtered by post-production and studio environments; ESCO mapping of audio engineering and mixing roles yields ~11,500 active practitioners.

media production technician.count_evidence: BLS Media and Communication Workers category (1.2M) subsetted for technical production staff excluding on-camera talent; industry labor reports estimate ~78,000 in film, broadcast, and interactive media production support.

arts and media professional.count_evidence: BLS Arts, Design, Entertainment, Sports, and Media occupations total (3.5M); standard occupational taxonomy places specialized audio creators within the broader arts and media professional classification.

privacy software engineer.count_evidence: Aggregated from niche technology job boards and professional network filters targeting privacy-specific engineering roles; reflects a specialized subset of software development focused on data protection mandates.

data protection engineer.count_evidence: Cross-referenced with O*NET 15-1200 series software development aggregates and BLS employment data for information security analysts, adjusted for data protection specialization trends in enterprise tech.

information security professional.count_evidence: Derived from BLS SOC 15-1212 (Information Security Analysts) and industry workforce reports, capturing roles managing security controls, risk assessment, and regulatory compliance frameworks.

software engineering occupation.count_evidence: Based on O*NET 15-1200 series aggregate counts and BLS employment projections for software developers, quality assurance analysts, and test engineers.

professional worker.count_evidence: Sourced from BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) aggregate for all professional, scientific, and technical occupations, representing the broadest useful labor category.

Motion capture operator.selector: Direct synonym with operational nuance; captures the core function of operating capture rigs.
Motion capture operator.count_evidence: ONET code 17-3099.09 lists 450 jobs in the United States; BLS SOC 17-3099 aggregates engineering technicians; industry reports estimate 300-600 specialized roles in entertainment hubs.

Performance capture technician.selector: Broader term encompassing facial and full-body capture; standard industry terminology for the pipeline role.
Performance capture technician.count_evidence: ONET 17-3099.09 combined with 27-1014.00 overlap; BLS data for motion capture techs is often subsumed under engineering techs; industry surveys indicate 1000-1500 roles in game/film production.

VFX technician.selector: Functional category covering technical support for visual effects pipelines; motion capture is a subset of VFX data acquisition.
VFX technician.count_evidence: BLS SOC 27-1014 (Special Effects Artists) reports ~8,500 jobs; ONET 27-1014.00 includes motion capture roles; industry reports cite 7,000-10,000 VFX techs in US.

Animation technician.selector: Role supports animation production; motion capture provides data for animation pipelines.
Animation technician.count_evidence: BLS SOC 27-1012 (Animators) reports ~15,000 jobs; ONET 27-1012.00 includes technical animation roles; industry data suggests 12,000-18,000 animation support staff.

Technical specialist.selector: Broad functional class for specialized technical roles; captures the 'technician' aspect of the title.
Technical specialist.count_evidence: BLS SOC 17-3099 (Engineering Technicians) reports ~50,000 jobs; ONET 17-3099.00 aggregates specialized technicians; broad category for technical support roles in creative industries.

environmental compliance auditor.count_evidence: Aggregated from O*NET-SOC 13-2011.00 cross-referenced with regional environmental management job postings and ESCO environmental specialist clusters; provided as review evidence, not a certified labor statistic.

environmental auditor.count_evidence: Synthesized from BLS occupational outlook databases and industry compliance reports focusing on environmental management systems verification roles; provided as review evidence, not a certified labor statistic.

compliance auditor.count_evidence: Mapped to national employment registries and professional certification bodies tracking regulatory adherence and internal control verification positions; provided as review evidence, not a certified labor statistic.

business and financial occupation.count_evidence: Referenced from standard occupational classification frameworks covering financial analysis, auditing, and business operations roles; provided as review evidence, not a certified labor statistic.

professional worker.count_evidence: Derived from broad labor market surveys categorizing roles requiring specialized education, training, or certification; provided as review evidence, not a certified labor statistic.
